title: Circuit Gadget Beat
hook: Name the signal job before the gadget beat.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: friendly 3D science-and-robots storybook, supervised lab displays and toy-like machines, clean educational layouts; visual identity: Circuit Gadget Beat

creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: function recall -> target -> non-contact diagram gesture
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Circuit Gadget Beat a signal-chain song: capacitor, transistor, logic, microcontroller, DAC, LED, sensors and USB/networking transform/store/route signals; voltage regulator protects operating ranges.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child asks whether a component stores, switches, computes, converts, senses, communicates, or outputs—not whether it is simply a 'gadget part'.
